comparison.objective: Remove a named cartridge fuse with an insulated puller by rocking it out one end at a time.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick up tong puller, grip the correct fuse, lever sequentially against clips, and transport it without disturbing neighbors versus rotate and lock a setting.
comparison.success_condition: Requires F2 removed while held by the tool and placed in a tray, with irreversible failure if F1/F3 move; no damping-cycle criterion. Rubric is complete.
comparison.reason: The record tests target selection and asymmetric lever extraction, not shock-absorber commissioning.
